Node.js 16 (nodejs16.x) has reached end-of-life. AWS no longer ships security patches for this runtime — any known CVEs in the runtime itself will remain unpatched indefinitely. Update your CDK/SAM/serverless.yml — change runtime from nodejs16.x to nodejs22.x 2. Test locally — the function code rarely needs changes unless it uses APIs removed in the new runtime 3.
